title: LINGLANMIDIAN: SYSTEMATIC EVALUATION OF LLMS ON TCM KNOWLEDGE AND CLINICAL REASONING
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs on Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), which is described as a culturally rooted system with its own distinctive ontology and reasoning patterns. Most notably, the benchmark includes a specific evaluation component for 'Medical Ethics' as part of the TCM Licensing Examination (TLE) subtask, which accounts for approximately 1.58% of the TLE items.
